title: Long delay radio echoes heard by Norwegian operators
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Long delay radio echoes heard by Norwegian operators, about 1927 at Norway, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The story begins back in 1927. Norwegian shortwave radio operators began to notice something odd.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the story begins in 1927, when Norwegian shortwave radio operators started to notice something odd: their signals seemed to come back as echoes long after they were sent. He links the story to Karl Stormer, a Norwegian scientist of the time. If the echoes came from something out in space, it could mean an unknown object was near Earth.
